about: Evergreen oddity: Russell's 6 was retired league-wide in 2022; Jaylin Williams (OKC) is the last player allowed to wear it. His real quote included. Passes the quality gate. The 'last wearer' claim rests on Yahoo (Oct 2025) and an ESPN roster check; 'one man is left' matches Yahoo.
name: Why only one man can wear six
pinned: Was retiring Russell's six for all 30 teams the right honor, or should players still get to wear it? Would you have let Jaylin keep it?
postNote: POSTED by the user Oct 5 as 'Why Two Men Can Still Wear Six' (~29K views in about a day).
